summary: Form scope: lower greenhouse, sloping crowned bonnet, modest fender swell, round lamp pair, body-colour bumpers and eight-spoke wheels.
notes: Actual three-quarter comparison and current profile checked after geometry Tier1 passed. Simple stylized reconstruction, not an exact copy; cabin margins remain angular but connected. Material sheen, pale window reflections and wheel tonal finish are deferred to material stage. Rear hatch and trim anchoring remain interaction checks before release.

features.notes: Hatch silhouette and short nose retained; lower greenhouse fits better.
Flares and closed liners meet true wheel openings.
Two doors, fixed quarter panes, painted window margins and seated cabin.
Two circular front lamps, horizontal grille, fixed rear corner lamps and body-colour bumpers.
